redshiftUncertainty: Not supplied in Obs_info; quality flags are not sigma.

qualityFlags.A: Highly robust: S/N>5 emission lines in R~1000 data
qualityFlags.B: Highly robust: S/N>5 emission lines in Prism/Clear
qualityFlags.C: Secure: visually identified spectral breaks and/or low S/N emission lines
qualityFlags.D: Tentative redshift; not used for map distance
qualityFlags.E: No redshift; raw sentinel retained only in observations
